1. introduce the beta plan of boardx, education, design thinking, community etc.
2. discuss the next step opportunity

Event Name: 15 Minute Meeting

Please share anything that will help prepare for our meeting.: We would like to tell you what our organization does, and seek advice on how best to navigate the platform to these ends.We call the platform the Global Village Square to share best practices, profiles , events, and collaborations amoung hundreds of organizations worldwide involved in digital media literacy. We would like "topics" back if possible. And we want to showcase the site at a conference we are hosting March 2-4, 2023.
